data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall Booking → xe → mail-draft flow and the subject/body templates right, but it omits the "first hotel with score ≥8" selection rule (it says "chosen hotel"), has the final step as Send instead of Discard (which contradicts the "do not send" instruction), and uses recipient_email instead of {traveler}@example.com, so a build from this spec would be partly wrong and underspecified.
